analysis: paired Hoeffding lower bounds for each answerable family versus initial and reset; exact one-sided binomial bounds for unknown recognition and high-confidence errors; Bonferroni across six bounds
samplingUnit: held-out task conditional on this trained agent and generated world; not an independent agent lineage
stopping: fixed corpus; retain failures; no retries, tuning or optional stopping
limitations: Engineered transfer test, not a field qualification or general intelligence claim.
Feedback supplies correct input-output examples; model weights remain fixed.
Only production GenOS memory storage and abstention policy are exercised, not autonomous orchestration.
Oracle is a separate local process by the same author, not an independent laboratory.
Confidence is supplied with the answer before oracle feedback, not before reasoning.
Calibration thresholds are descriptive gates; six simultaneous bounds cover transfer and ignorance only.
No claim about pretraining exposure to affine reasoning; only generated aliases and exact tasks are new.
